scope: Complete standalone generated public Boolean polynomial systems only. No curve inputs, imported targets, scalar recovery, production IC integration or rho campaign.
fixtures: n+2 equations, twelve distinct quadratic monomials and up to four linear monomials per equation. Planted families choose constants to satisfy a public reproducible Boolean witness that is never passed to the solver. Cross-planted makes a pair differ by a valid affine consequence. Unplanted constants are independent; its status is established by complete search when available. No fixture screening.
ordering: Four deterministic Fisher-Yates permutations per fixture; every permutation is followed by its exact reverse. The per-fixture seed is order_seed XOR (n<<48) XOR (seed<<8) XOR family_index, reduced modulo 2^64. SplitMix64 supplies the draws; pair p starts at seed XOR (p*0xd1b54a32d192ed03). This replaces cyclic neighbors after same-kernel aliases showed discovery timing differences. No within-fixture all-position or instruction-cache-cold claim is made.
final_gate: Each candidate must have a paired 95 percent lower bound above 2.0 versus the pointwise fastest fixed reference at every n16/20/24, family and regression/holdout group. All 18 groups and all 192-cell completions and verification are required. If the candidate is in the reference roster, remove only itself. Separate >1.0 incremental and >1.05 matched-control gates cannot replace this condition. Any eligible treatment requires unchanged timed-source confirmation with unused holdouts. No tuning after holdout timing.
accounting: Every cold context includes encoding, coefficient images, all setup, schedules, projection checks, secondary and full checks, recovery, destruction and validation. Partial points, secondary checks, full checks and fallback points are separate counters. partial_ns is an exclusive measured subset. full_update_words counts u32 low-linear coefficient updates; secondary_update_words counts updates to a packed u64 containing six secondary bytes. They are distinct counters, not a calibrated operation unit. Prefix diagnostics remain in leaf controls; enumeration checksums are omitted in quiet controls and final partial arms. Fixture generation, retained search-status preparation and record formatting are outside arm timers and inside process receipts.
correctness: Partial nonzero syndromes reject exactly; every partial survivor is checked through the next eight equations and then all original equations. The single-stage control checks all original equations after the first filter. All complete first models equal retained Gray enumeration; leaf methods preserve the retained prefix and original-label recovery. Full-word controls evaluate all 32 equation planes. Byte, plane, scalar and compiled-schedule versions preserve semantic work within their policy. Quiet timing arms have null traces; instrumented test modes retain trace equality. UNKNOWN remains censored.
selection: Seven immutable discovery probes use only n16/n24 seeds17/937. They retain initial byte projection, inlining and empty-block skipping, deferred coefficient updates, quiet two-stage refinement, bit-plane representation, compiled 64-point schedules and compiled 16-point schedules. The dispatcher is fixed before holdout timing: 16-point compiled scheduling through n20 and 64-point compiled scheduling above it. Selecting between those new components is not claimed to beat their pointwise minimum. Primary random/reverse orders test timing differences seen under cyclic discovery orders.
